thread:
maria: quick thread 1 Acme agreed to a 3-month POC. Need a compact capacity recommendation: reserved GPUs, autoscale floor/ceiling, and short pricing delta for presales. Also security questionnaire items (KMS/VPC/logs) due EOD. who can take throughput shape?

ben: tagging @carla @dmitri. what are avg vs burst figures?

carla: workload = public chat + embeddings. steady QPS ~250, short bursts to ~2k QPS for 10-20s, median tokens/request ~140, 95p latency target 300ms. model = open-13B q4.

dmitri: back-of-envelope: steady 250 qps -> 35k tokens/s. measured 13B-q4 ~18k toks/s per GPU -> baseline 2 GPUs, add 20% headroom -> 3. bursts -> 2k qps -> 280k toks/s -> naive ~16 GPUs. with aggressive KV caching and microbatching we often reduce burst need ~2.5x -> ~6 GPUs. recommend reserve options: 4 (cost-opt), 6 (balanced), 8 (safe). autoscale to max 12-16 depending on cache. fallback: smaller 7B model or soft-throttle.

ben: sample autoscale snippet for presales doc:
```
autoscale_policy: min_reserved=4; max_scale=16; metric=tokens_per_sec; scale_up_threshold=0.75; cool_down=2m; preheat=true; fallback_model=7B-q4
```

maria: perfect. dmitri, confirm security Q answers for Dedicated/Private (KMS, VPC, audit logs)?

dmitri: yes: customer-managed KMS supported, VPC peering/PrivateLink for Dedicated, audit logs streamable to S3/CloudWatch, RBAC and TLS in transit. will attach one-pager.

carla: i'll draft the POC runbook: recommended reserve 4 (with presales price), option tables for 6/8, autoscale policy, KV warmup checklist, and fallback wording for contracts.

maria: timeline 1 need draft by 1700 PT. can you confirm?

ben: I'll paste perf numbers by 1500.

carla: I'll assemble doc by 1630.

ops-bot: preheat job queued: job_id=preheat-5456789123-1 target_gpus=4 kv_warmup=true

maria: thanks team. I'll update customer and loop in finance. :thumbsup:
